2034-2653-7090-8345.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2724-7715-8172.easyPrerequisites: The Mighty Thor doesn't have summoning sickness.
2724-7715-8172.description:
Declare The Mighty Thor as an attacker, attacking an opponent that cannot kill it in combat.
When The Mighty Thor attacks, it triggers, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

3311-7863--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3311-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage.
Snake Umbra triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

394-856-5776-8095.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4681-4730-6495-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.
4681-4730-6495-6542.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-3836-5131-5226--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3836-5131-5226--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Urza.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

997-5662--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-5662--5--195.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3944-5220-6900-7492.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying its mana cost.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2447-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
2447-3259-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5686-7084-7422.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-2155-3259.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
1879-2155-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2155-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3967-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3967-5687-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3967-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Yahenni.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1169-1256-1270-5477.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1308-4017-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-4017-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

360-3490-4017-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-3490-4017-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-2608-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lion's Eye Diamond.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1781-1978-2436.description:
Cause Marwyn to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-2741-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2741-4186.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-5658-6753.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to create two token copies of Éomer and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Put both Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Éomer tokens trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

222-527-5256-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5256-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

5352-5847-5921.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, creating two token copies of Caretaker's Talent and a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {W}.
When the Caretaker's Talent tokens enter the battlefield, they each trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate a land token by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate a Caretaker's Talent token by paying {W}, causing it to become level 2. The token's second ability triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a copy of a land token.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a copy of a Caretaker's Talent token.
When the Caretaker's Talent token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

2607-6004.easyPrerequisites: Grievous Wound attached to an opponent.
2607-6004.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to the opponent that has Grievous Wound attached to them.
2607-6004.description:
Deal damage to the opponent that has Grievous Wound attached to them.
Grievous Wound triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent with Grievous Wound attached loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1429-2438-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2438-5958.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1506-2178-4227.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1506-2178-4227.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

3101-3199-3209.manaNeeded: {3}{R}, plus an additional {X} available, where X is equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin
3101-3199-3209.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least one untapped green creature.
3101-3199-3209.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate its ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Sprout Swarm by paying {1} and tapping a green creature you control.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

1381-4050-5093-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gnarled Scarhide, adding {B}.
When Gnarled Scarhide dies, Mortuary and Ashiok's Reaper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Gnarled Scarhide on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ashiok's Render trigger, causing you to draw Gnarled Scarhide from your library.
Cast Gnarled Scarhide by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1300-3906.notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two mana-producing lands and/or creatures, one of which must be able to produce at least {G}.
1300-3906.description:
At the beginning of the next upkeep, Awakening triggers.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing lands and creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Awakening's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Awakening's trigger, untapping all lands and creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

431-1636.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Merfolk.
431-1636.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven Merfolk you control, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
The Merfolk token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1378-2105.notablePrerequisites: Mirage Phalanx is paired with Combat Celebrant.
1378-2105.description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Mirage Phalanx and Combat Celebrant each trigger.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, creating a token copy of it with haste and without soulbond.
The Mirage Phalanx token enters the battlefield, triggering Mirage Phalanx's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, choosing not to pair it with the Mirage Phalanx token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger from step 1, creating a token copy of it with haste.
The Combat Celebrant token enters the battlefield, triggering Mirage Phalanx's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, choosing not to pair it with the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, allowing you to exert it to untap all other creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

1256-1912-4289-5153.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
1256-1912-4289-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Saproling token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

1218-1525-2396-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Ophidian Eye attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
1218-1525-2396-4298.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Borborygmos +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2034-2596.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2034-2596.description:
Cast Living Death by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Living Death.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Living Death
Resolve the Living Death copy, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, and returning all cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat from step 3.

2027-4468.description:
All creatures lose flying and Islandwalk.
Magus of the Moat prevents things without flying from attacking.
Creatures can not fulfill the conditions nessasary to attack.

3554-4377-4610.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Final Parting by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Final Parting and Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
